source_description_html:
Yoshimura Alpha T Works Street Slip-On Exhaust BMW S1000RR

The Works Alpha T Street Slip-On features Yoshimura's Works finished muffler sleeve that takes on a unique coloring after it goes through a heat cycle. This special finish treatment increases fatigue strength, scratch resistance and just looks cool.

Yoshimura R&D of America is proud to introduce Alpha line of exhaust. The Alpha Exhaust's styling, fit and finish are the results of investments made in technology and decades of experience with the latest in digital design capabilities. One look at an Alpha Exhaust and you know it's something special. The unique Tri-Oval design is especially striking from the rear, where the large-diameter carbon fiber end cap and well-integrated, draw-formed, slash-cut outlet can clearly be seen. But there's more to the Tri-oval design than its cutting-edge appearance. Along with improved lean-angle ground clearance, this shape allows better use of internal volume to produce the deep, distinct exhaust note Yoshimura is known for.

Features:

  • Beautiful shape resulting from tri-oval design heritage
  • Unrivaled fit and finish due to improved production tolerances
  • Optimized for maximum flow and improved ground clearance
  • Muffler volume and shape produces that magic tone Yoshimura is famous for
  • Optimized for durability and ease of service
  • Made in the USA

name: Yoshimura R55 Race Full Exhaust System for Suzuki Hayabusa
source_title: Yoshimura R55 Race Full Exhaust System for Suzuki Hayabusa
description: Yoshimura continues its tradition of making the Suzuki Hayabusa even better with the R-55 Full System.
source_description_html:
Yoshimura continues its tradition of making the Suzuki Hayabusa even better with the R-55 Full System.

The R-55 is currently one of Yoshimura's most popular pipes and for good reason. It's a hybrid of MotoGP, Superbike, and Yoshimura style, which makes for a pretty impressive package. It's asymmetrical shape appeals to the eye and really captures the spirit of MotoGP racing. It also complements the look of any sportbike, following the race-inspired lines of today's motorcycles.

The R-55 features a straight baffle with a removable low-volume insert. The pipe is TIG-welded to Yoshimura quality standards and constructed from high-quality polished stainless steel. The laser-cut mounting bracket is TIG-welded to ensure strength and good looks.

The Hayabusa R-55 Full System consists of a duplex stainless steel header on a MotoGP shorty tail-pipe and 10” R-55 full stainless muffler topped off with a laser-etched stainless end-cap.

While the RS-4 Exhaust was debuted as Yoshimura's premier exhaust for off-road racing applications, R&D couldn't stop there. They have mated this sophisticated and stylish muffler to compliment the styling of the new bike. The RS-4 is pentagonal shaped muffler that features a carbon fiber cone end cap, two staged stepped baffle and striking good looks. The RS-4 muffler features a new front cap design that functions as a polyresonant chamber. thus creating a more quiet muffler with improved mid to top end power.

Along with improving sound and power, this system moves the muffler weight lower and closer to the bike for improved handling and weight distribution. Yoshimura continues to provide the best in performance exhaust systems.

name: Yoshimura AT2 Slip-On Exhaust for Honda CB750 Hornet
source_title: Yoshimura AT2 Slip-On Exhaust for Honda CB750 Hornet
description: The Honda CB750 Hornet is here and Yoshimura has the insane sound and look of the AT2 Street Series slip-on ready to go!
source_description_html:
The Honda CB750 Hornet is here and Yoshimura has the insane sound and look of the AT2 Street Series slip-on ready to go!

As soon as we heard the CB750 Hornet was coming to the USA we got excited! We're big fans of the 755cc parallel twin engine and in the chassis of the CB Hornet, this bike is a blast to ride.

Giving the 750 hornet more performance is what we are here for and our AT2 makes it happen.

Our slip-on helps the New Hornet loose a substantial amount of weight. 3.4 lbs. to be exact. In the performance numbers the AT2 can provide up to 1.5% more HP at 8,500 rpm and up to 2% more torque at 7,500 rpm. doesn't stop there. The exhaust note that the AT2 produces makes is second to none! The AT2 also comes with a custom carbon fiber heal guard.

Yoshimura's AT2 is designed, developed and manufactured in Chino California.

Weights:
Stock system: 8.2 lbs.
Yoshimura AT2: 4.8 lbs

Sound levels: (Using J2825 standards)

2000 rpm
Stock: 82.3dB
AT2: 93.6dB

5000 rpm
Stock: 91.6dB
AT2: 101.4dB

description: The Ninja 1100 SX with its racetrack roots has been developing some of its own roots now for touring and weekend trips. Yoshimura is here… • Stock muffler: 11.4 Lbs. VS Yoshimura carbon fiber Alpha Slip-on: 6.1 Lbs.. • Contemporary Satin/matte finish. • Uniform heat coloration. • Increased fatigue strength.
source_description_html:
The Ninja 1100 SX with its racetrack roots has been developing some of its own roots now for touring and weekend trips. Yoshimura is here to refine performance.

With a solid base 1043cc inline 4 cylinder engine, this new Ninja is radically smooth! One of the areas we focused on was to give the Ninja more giddy up on top and our Alpha slip- on delivered! With an increase of 4% max horsepower and 4.7% max torque, it's safe to say the Kawasaki Ninja 1000 SX is even funner to ride.

The sound note that the Alpha delivers has even been taken into consideration. Nobody wants a big drone sound in their helmet after a nice ride. The Alpha is ear pleasing while letting others know you're there. We saved some weight too! The Alpha carbon sleeve version removes almost 6 pounds of weight from the back of the new Ninja 1000!

The Alpha slip-on system is proudly made in the U.S.A.

  • Stock muffler: 11.4 Lbs. VS Yoshimura carbon fiber Alpha Slip-on: 6.1 Lbs.

New Yoshimura Works Finish takes on a unique coloring after it goes through a heat cycle on the motorcycle that looks much like those titanium works components our factory racers use.

  • Contemporary Satin/matte finish
  • Uniform heat coloration
  • Increased fatigue strength
  • Increased scratch and stain resistance

description: The Ninja 1100 SX with its racetrack roots has been developing some of its own roots now for touring and weekend trips. Yoshimura is here… • Stock muffler: 11.4 Lbs. VS Yoshimura carbon fiber Alpha Slip-on: 5.5 Lbs.. • Contemporary Satin/matte finish. • Uniform heat coloration. • Increased fatigue strength.
source_description_html:
The Ninja 1100 SX with its racetrack roots has been developing some of its own roots now for touring and weekend trips. Yoshimura is here to refine performance.

With a solid base 1043cc inline 4 cylinder engine, this new Ninja is radically smooth! One of the areas we focused on was to give the Ninja more giddy up on top and our Alpha slip- on delivered! With an increase of 4% max horsepower and 4.7% max torque, it's safe to say the Kawasaki Ninja 1000 SX is even more fun to ride.

The sound note that the Alpha delivers has even been taken into consideration. Nobody wants a big drone sound in their helmet after a nice ride. The Alpha is ear pleasing while letting others know you're there. We saved some weight too! The Alpha carbon sleeve version removes almost 6 pounds of weight from the back of the new Ninja 1000!

The Alpha slip-on system is proudly made in the U.S.A.

  • Stock muffler: 11.4 Lbs. VS Yoshimura carbon fiber Alpha Slip-on: 5.5 Lbs.

New Yoshimura Works Finish takes on a unique coloring after it goes through a heat cycle on the motorcycle that looks much like those titanium works components our factory racers use.

  • Contemporary Satin/matte finish
  • Uniform heat coloration
  • Increased fatigue strength
  • Increased scratch and stain resistance

Updated base design includes:

  • Manufactured using powder-coated stainless steel and aluminum materials
  • Includes all stainless-steel hardware
  • Integrated fasteners (to eliminate the need for a third hand)

The race bred R-11Sq R is now available from Yoshimura R&D and goodness... these Race Series slip-ons are absolutely exquisite.

The R-11Sq R dual slip-ons are available in a satin stainless steel and a beautiful blued titanium sleeve, both with beautiful R-11Sq R carbon fiber end caps and custom made carbon fiber heat shields. name: Yoshimura R-77 Dual Slip-On Exhaust for Suzuki Hayabusa 2022
source_title: Yoshimura R-77 Dual Slip-On Exhaust for Suzuki Hayabusa 2022
description: Introducing our new Onyx Edition, a look as exclusive as it sounds. What better motorcycle to debut on than the 2022 Suzuki Hayabusa. • Contemporary Satin/matte finish. • Uniform heat coloration. • Increased fatigue strength. • Increased scratch and stain resistance.
source_description_html:
Introducing our new Onyx Edition, a look as exclusive as it sounds. What better motorcycle to debut on than the 2022 Suzuki Hayabusa.

Onyx Edition is a proprietary plating process with a beautiful dark mirror-like finish. Yoshimura has been in development of Onyx Edition with an outside partner for over two years on this process. The result is a long lasing luxurious deep shine that has outstanding durability along with exceptional UV and temperature resistance. Maintenance is as easy as wiping down with mild soap or standard (non-caustic) cleaner and a microfiber towel.

Two versions of R-77 Race Series Onyx Edition duals are available for the new Busa, a carbon fiber end cap or a stainless end cap with the Onyx treatment. Both are stunning and attached to our exclusive Works Finish tailpipes.

Want more than an esthetic reason? Of course there are performance advantages too! The R-77 dual mufflers reduce as much weight as 11.2 pounds! Horsepower and torque are up, and the exhaust note of the dual Yoshimura R-77's is a classic as the Hayabusa name!

Our R-77 slip-ons and Onyx Edition is proudly developed, designed and Made in the USA.

New Yoshimura Works Finish takes on a unique coloring after it goes through a heat cycle on the motorcycle that looks much like those titanium works components our factory racers use.

  • Contemporary Satin/matte finish
  • Uniform heat coloration
  • Increased fatigue strength
  • Increased scratch and stain resistance

source_description_html:
Our AT2 Street Series slip-on is just what the brand new Honda CB1000 Hornet SP was asking for. At last the AT2 is here to enhance an already stunning naked liter machine!

Now the big Hornet sounds mean and has extra ponies to boot with the AT2 slip-on, and nothing beats the sound performance and looks of the AT2.

The Honda 1000cc inline 4 engine responded to our Street Series AT2 with a resounding YES! This slip-on provides more power and torque across the entire spectrum! Power gains are up to 4.2% more HP @10,000 rpm and up to 3% more torque @9,600 rpm, and it doesn't stop there. Our slip-on with a custom carbon fiber heal guard helps the new CB1000 Hornet SP loose a substantial amount of weight, 6.7 lbs! That over half the weight from stock. The exhaust note that our AT2 produces is second to none!

Yoshimura's AT2 is designed, developed and manufactured in Chino California.

description: Introducing the latest from our R&D team at Yoshimura - AT2 Street Series 3/4 system for the Kawasaki ZX-6R. • Stock muffler weight: 16.1 Lbs. vs Yoshimura AT2 3/4 System weight: 5.3 Lbs..
source_description_html:
Introducing the latest from our R&D team at Yoshimura - AT2 Street Series 3/4 system for the Kawasaki ZX-6R.

Without a doubt the Kawasaki ZX-6R is one of the hottest middle weight sport bikes in the market. Never the ones to settle, we continually refine our offerings thus we have developed our new AT2 3/4 system for this racing legend.

This new system incorporates our exclusive Works Finish featuring an aggressively styled matte finish carbon fiber end cap and heal guard complimented by a facet-formed tip. Our AT2 comes in at an incredible 10.8 pound weight savings making this system a winner already!

The performance results were amazing in our development as well! More linear throttle response and torque made the ZX-6R come alive with max HP at 2.1% and peak torque gains of 4.7% the green machine is ready to rise to the top of the podium. Oh yeah, and that distinctive Yoshimura AT2 exhaust note will have your heart revving for more! INS-20-K sound insert is supplied with this system.

AT2 is proudly developed, designed and made in the USA.

  • Stock muffler weight: 16.1 Lbs. vs Yoshimura AT2 3/4 System weight: 5.3 Lbs.

This product was designed to fit on a standard equipped motorcycle, as delivered from the factory. OE and aftermarket accessories not found on a bike as delivered from the factory may not be compatible with this product.

Attention international customers: This product was designed and tested to be compatible with vehicles in the U.S. marketplace only. Compatibility, including fitment and performance, may vary by marketplace.

source_description_html:
The new Kawasaki ZX-4RR sport bike is one special machine. Engineers at Kawasaki set out to develop a 400cc inline four cylinder engine built for high performance, and they delivered.

For this special machine we used our AT2 muffler to develop a Street Series Works Finish slip-on giving power to the 16,000 + RPM's of the new Kawasaki powerplant. The AT2 came through in performance, sound, and weight savings. HP was bumped up by an increase of 3% and torque was bumped up as well, adding 4.3%. Our mission of adding power and torque throughout the entire spectrum was accomplished. Our AT2 Slip-on removed 4.5 pounds from the stock formation.

The sound of this inline four at 16,000 rpms with our AT2 is simply something that must be experienced in real life. True music! Finally, the styling of the AT2 can't be beat. It's now iconic matte carbon fiber end cap and heat shield compliment the lines of the ZX-4RR to perfection.

Our AT2 slip-on is proudly designed and manufactured in Chino, California.

New Yoshimura Works Finish takes on a unique coloring after it goes through a heat cycle on the motorcycle that looks much like those titanium works components our factory racers use.

  • Contemporary Satin/matte finish
  • Uniform heat coloration
  • Increased fatigue strength
  • Increased scratch and stain resistance
